heading: Workplace Mental Health Sheets
intro: Printed guides and quick tips for your staff room, HR desk or noticeboard. Written by Kelly, a BACP-registered psychotherapist, so your team gets clear, practical information they can trust.
image1Alt: Three printed mental health sheets from Kelly Marie Wellbeing

rangeItems.text: 8 Understanding guides: ADHD, anxiety, panic attacks, depression, autism, mental health at work, self-esteem and sleep
7 Quick Tips sheets for when someone's struggling: panic attacks, anger, low mood, workplace wellbeing, loneliness, stress and sleep
Every Quick Tips sheet has a box for your own support contacts, so staff know exactly who to go to
Samaritans and emergency numbers on every sheet
A5 size, made to sit in a leaflet holder or pin to a board

image2Alt: A Quick Tips sheet with a box for the company's own support contacts
orderText: Tell us which sheets you'd like and roughly how many copies, and we'll come back to you with a price.
brandedHeading: Want your own support contacts on them?
brandedText: We can print your support contacts on every Quick Tips sheet, so staff know exactly who to go to. Ask us about it when you enquire.
image3Alt: All 15 sheets in the Kelly Marie Wellbeing range

faqs.question: Can I order just some of the sheets?
faqs.answer: Yes. Pick the topics that suit your team.

faqs.question: Can you add our support contacts?
faqs.answer: Yes. Mention it in your enquiry.

faqs.question: Do you offer training too?
faqs.answer: Yes. Kelly Marie Wellbeing runs mental health training for managers and HR teams.
